vignette: A child in the mixed dentition is seen for a routine visit, and the clinician notes a developing malocclusion. The parent asks whether every child with a developing malocclusion needs interceptive appliance treatment started right away.
stem: Which statement about interceptive treatment is best supported?

options.text: Interceptive treatment benefits many children, but it is not necessarily indicated for every patient with a developing malocclusion.
Every patient with a developing malocclusion should receive interceptive treatment.
Appliance therapy for habits is limited to extraoral appliances.
Once a space maintainer is placed, no further checks are needed, since it requires no patient cooperation.
